commands.command: Build or audit a retention corpus from the M133 strict proof-surface rows before any further PPO continuation.
commands.name: m136_m133_proof_surface_retention_corpus

decision_rule: Do not restart PPO until the strict proof-surface rows that M134/M135 shrink are represented as an explicit retention corpus or objective guard.
failure_criteria: corpus is dominated by duplicate physical pairs
corpus ignores the M133 rows that M134/M135 lost
next PPO proceeds without a proof-surface retention guard
hypothesis: M134 and M135 show that generic PPO with M128 outcome loss and action anchors can retain behavior but shrink M133 strict selected-seed diversity. The next repair should make the fresh M133 proof surface itself a retained training or gate artifact before PPO resumes.
success_criteria: M133 strict accepted snippets and selected physical pairs are represented with provenance
M134/M135 regression rows are identified or recoverable
source condition coverage is reported explicitly
the next PPO/objective recipe has a concrete proof-surface retention guard
